title: Congruences of strict local rings on corresponding admissible blowups
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair with $I$ finitely generated and $A'=\widehat A$ its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Set $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $X'=\operatorname{Spec}A'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For a finitely generated ideal $J\subseteq A$ with $V(J)=V(I)$ let $Y_J=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$ and $Y'_J=\operatorname{Bl}_{JA'}(X')$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. Then the canonical map induces isomorphisms of infinitesimal closed fibres
$$Y'_J\times_{X'}\operatorname{Spec}(A'/I^nA')\xrightarrow{\sim}Y_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^n)\quad(n\geq1).$$
Choose a compatible system $\bar t_J$ of geometric points on the closed fibres of the $Y_J$, and the corresponding system $\bar t'_J$ on the $Y'_J$, using the same separable residue-field closures. Define
$$B=\varinjlim_J\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y_J,\bar t_J},\qquad C=\varinjlim_J\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y'_J,\bar t'_J},$$
where the colimits use domination of blowups and strict henselizations [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. The induced homomorphism $u:B\to C$ gives isomorphisms $B/I^nB\xrightarrow{\sim}C/I^nC$ for all $n\geq1$. In particular, if $IB=(\varphi)$ and $\varphi'=u(\varphi)$, these are the maps $B/\varphi^nB\xrightarrow{\sim}C/(\varphi')^nC$.
